scope: Closure of v1 cleanup-exception masking finding in ordinary and diagnostic observers
Closure of v1 bounded-lock waiting finding including snapshot/admission-lock interaction
Dispatcher quarantine, idempotent call release and retained version lifetime
Positive call-accounting scope and retained source-bound regression evidence
method: Read-only source/diff/control-flow and retained evidence review. No repository code, tests, native child, compiler or timing experiment executed by reviewer. Only independent file hashing and git-diff comparison were performed.

issue_closures.ordinary_path: _observe_native keeps the actual cleanup owner outside TemporaryFile contexts. Its outermost finally checks cleanup.confirmed after context exits and restores NativeChildCleanupPending with bounded secondary diagnostics when reap remains unconfirmed.
issue_closures.diagnostic_path: _observe attempts every tracked pipe close and retains bounded secondary errors. _run final ownership handling checks self._cleanup.confirmed regardless surviving exception type, clears a tentative result and quarantines instead of releasing an unconfirmed child.
issue_closures.evidence: Both actual-child controls errored on the initial draft; both pass in the repaired three-method and complete focused runs.

issue_closures.mechanism: A separate reap-serialization lock uses nonblocking acquisition for zero timeout or a bounded acquisition otherwise. The deadline is established before acquisition and recomputed before Popen.wait. Short-held metadata locking covers only state; neither snapshots nor confirmed reads wait behind the OS process wait.
issue_closures.lock_order: No process wait or reap-lock acquisition occurs while the metadata lock is held; no immediate cycle found with dispatcher/probe conditions. Dispatcher snapshots may read metadata while holding admission lock but no longer inherit the long reap wait.
issue_closures.evidence: The actual-child concurrency control failed before repair and passes afterward. Its 0.5-second event deadline detects the prior two-second lock convoy; it does not prove exact 20-millisecond real-time scheduling.

boundary_resolution.detail: Documentation now explicitly requires direct observers to retain exception.cleanup and retry until confirmed. The standalone differential runner may close its parent pin while propagating Pending; child-side inherited descriptor remains owned by that child. Dispatcher quarantine/drain claims require retaining the dispatcher. No global recovery registry or crash-durable recovery is claimed.

reviewed_test_properties: Withheld reap controls first observe actual child exit through WNOWAIT; the same original Popen wait later reaps it.
Parent-finalizer controls close the actual resource before injecting the extra error and assert that dispatch stays in-flight, not drained.
Concurrent recovery control blocks the real child wait path and checks zero-time retry, snapshot and short close without requiring a fabricated successful native result.
Old-code negative controls include fallback reap of tracked original child objects and inode-checked residual-pipe cleanup.
Source/version recovery is idempotent; earlier failed observations remain failed; no native re-execution is introduced.
